tagline: Real FPS gains. Proven, reversible, near-zero footprint.
brief: A free, lightweight Windows optimiser for PC gamers. It fixes only what measurably helps (RAM speed, refresh rate, background bloat) and proves every gain with before/after benchmarks. The mark should feel sharp, precise and game-ready, and avoid optimiser clichés like rockets, speedometers and flames.
criteria: Success: reads as gaming and performance at a glance, distinct from snake-oil optimisers, works at 16 px in the tray and taskbar, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Lock-On F
concepts.idea: Frame corners form a targeting reticle: the left corner is the F, and its middle arm aims straight at the target.
rationale: Reticle = gaming and precision: FrameWise locks onto the issues that really cost FPS
Frame corners = the 'Frame' in the name; violet frame and cyan target follow the app's own colour tokens
Custom squared wordmark shares the mark's stroke, corners and cyan dot (on the i)
Separate small-size cut keeps the F and target readable at 16 px in the tray

recommendation: Lock-On F: ownable in a category full of rockets and speedometers, strong at icon sizes, and built from the same parts as the app UI.
next_steps: Drop the icon set into the Tauri project (npx tauri icon export/app-icon-large/framewise-app-icon-app-icon-1024.png)
Run a trademark search on the name and mark before launch
Use the symbol as the tray icon and the reticle corners as UI accents (scan, focus states)
